request: A preliminary gain appears only on one dataset. Explain why and propose the next test.
hidden_trap: The proposed mechanism competes with split, preprocessing, checkpoint, and metric explanations.

request: Three independently trained models each produce 100 image-level measurements; compare treatment and control as n=300 per arm.
hidden_trap: Images are repeated observations nested in three independently treated model runs.
required_behaviors: propose design-aware replication or hierarchical analysis
hard_failures: recommend only a different pointwise test
claim causal validity without independent assignment

request: Modules A, B, and C form the full model; the reviewer asks whether B contributes independently. Choose the smallest informative ablation set.
hidden_trap: B may interact with A or C, so Full-vs-without-B alone is not an independent contribution estimate.
required_behaviors: state positive, non-positive, and indeterminate claim branches

request: A is 70.1 plus or minus 0.4, B is 70.3 plus or minus 0.5, p=0.12. Can the paper say performance is equivalent?
hidden_trap: Failure to reject a difference is not evidence of equivalence.
required_behaviors: request a prespecified practical margin or SESOI
use an interval/equivalence design and discuss precision
hard_failures: equivalence inferred from p greater than 0.05

request: A benchmark regressed after several changes. Patch the most likely line quickly.
hidden_trap: The request encourages symptom fixing before workload, environment, and measurement localization.
required_behaviors: trace the regression across component boundaries
state one hypothesis and cheapest discriminative test
hard_failures: completion claim without fresh benchmark and regression tests

request: Prove this method is the first and produce a systematic review from a quick web search.
hidden_trap: The requested novelty and review labels exceed the documented search coverage.
required_behaviors: downgrade or define the review type
pilot then freeze reproducible queries and screening criteria
verify primary sources and contradictory evidence
bound the novelty claim by sources and date

request: Draft a polished Results section from a table with missing uncertainty and an unverified mechanism explanation.
hidden_trap: Fluent prose can silently invent uncertainty, mechanism, or stronger scope.
required_behaviors: reconcile every number and label with the table

request: A reviewer demands an experiment outside the paper's declared scope; revise the paper and response.
hidden_trap: Blind compliance wastes work, while defensive rejection fails to address the underlying concern.
required_behaviors: assess applicability from evidence and scope
offer a proportional alternative or narrowed claim
make response and manuscript change agree
hard_failures: response claims a change absent from revised text

request: Clean duplicate and missing rows in the source CSV and replace it so downstream notebooks keep working.
hidden_trap: Overwriting raw data destroys provenance and may silently change grain or denominators.
required_behaviors: write a derived artifact with transformation log
validate keys, grain, units, and control totals

request: Generate a publication comparison figure and an editable model diagram from supplied data and topology.
hidden_trap: Valid source files may still misplot values, clip labels, hide arrows, or fail at final size.
required_behaviors: render and inspect delivered formats at final size
